## What I migrated

**`bot/openai_helper.py`** — the sole LLM integration point — now talks to Router's Responses-compatible surface for every chat/vision/function-calling call:

- New `self.client = openai.AsyncOpenAI(api_key=RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY, base_url=RAMP_ROUTER_BASE_URL)`, used for all `responses.create()` calls.
- `messages` → `input`; the leading system/assistant priming message → `instructions`; vision content parts `image_url`/`text` → `input_image`/`input_text`; `max_tokens`/`max_completion_tokens` → `max_output_tokens`.
- Legacy `functions`/`function_call` Chat Completions flow rewritten to Responses' native tool-calling: flat function specs → `tools` (`type: "function"`, `strict: False` since plugin schemas don't comply with strict-mode requirements), `function_call='auto'` → `tool_choice`, and the old `role: "function"` history entries → native `function_call`/`function_call_output` input items tracked by `call_id`. `parallel_tool_calls: False` preserves the original one-call-per-round behavior.
- Streaming rewritten around Responses SSE events (`response.output_text.delta` for incremental text, `response.completed` for the final `Response` object with real `usage`), replacing the old `chunk.choices[0].delta` loop. Intermediate function-calling rounds run silently (same as before); only the final round streams to the user.
- `response.choices[0].message.content` → `response.output_text`; `usage.prompt_tokens/completion_tokens` → `usage.input_tokens/output_tokens`.
- Upgraded `openai` from 1.58.1 (no Responses API) to `>=1.99,<2` in `requirements.txt`, and verified against the Router simulator (text-only, streaming, function-call direct-result, function-call continuation round, and vision — 6/6 requests valid at `POST /v1/responses`).
- Model names stay config-driven (`OPENAI_MODEL`, `VISION_MODEL`); `OPENAI_MODEL` is now required with no hardcoded fallback, since Router model ids are account-specific and I won't guess one. `VISION_MODEL` falls back to `OPENAI_MODEL` rather than a guessed id.
- Dropped `presence_penalty`/`frequency_penalty` and `n` (choices) — Responses has no equivalent parameters. Fixed two pre-existing OpenAI-model-literal lookups (`__max_model_tokens`, `__count_tokens_vision`) that otherwise raised `NotImplementedError` for any non-`gpt-*` Router model id — they now fall back to the newest-tier budget instead of crashing every turn.
- `main.py`/`.env.example`/`README.md` updated: `RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY`/`RAMP_ROUTER_BASE_URL` added, `OPENAI_API_KEY` is no longer required for chat.

## Call sites I could not migrate

Router only exposes `GET /v1/models` and `POST /v1/responses` (plus an Anthropic compat surface this app doesn't use). Three methods call OpenAI endpoints with no Router equivalent, so they still use a **separate** direct OpenAI client, gated on an optional `OPENAI_API_KEY` (never sent to Router):

- `generate_image` — `images.generate` (DALL·E)
- `generate_speech` — `audio.speech.create` (TTS)
- `transcribe` — `audio.transcriptions.create` (Whisper)

If `OPENAI_API_KEY` isn't set, these raise a clear error at call time rather than failing silently; everything else (chat, streaming, vision, plugin/function-calling, conversation summarization) runs entirely through Router.
